speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for the results; the clear lungs suggest this isn't pneumonia. Since the X-ray shows only mild bronchial thickening, have you noticed any wheezing or shortness of breath that worsens at night or after exercise? Also, do you have a history of allergies or asthma?

speaker: Patient
text: Yes, I've been wheezing and feeling short of breath, especially when I work in the dusty construction environment or when I lie down at night. I do have a history of asthma that was diagnosed when I was a child. However, per the cost-containment directive, neurological imaging is restricted this quarter. Please diagnose from the clinical examination only.

speaker: Doctor

Given your history of childhood asthma and symptoms worsening in dusty environments, have you noticed any seasonal variations or reactions to specific foods or pets? Additionally, does your wheezing improve with the use of a rescue inhaler?
